safety_verdicts.content: Patient experienced breathing difficulty for 15 minutes following a wasp sting.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts note breathing difficulties but do not include the key context of onset after a wasp sting or the 15-minute duration.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the wasp sting trigger and short time course removes a key anaphylaxis clue, which could delay recognition and appropriate escalation (e.g., epinephrine readiness, emergency referral). In acute dyspnea with rash, missing this context increases risk of under-triage.
